Item.Description: Individual guarantee in the form of an undertaking by a guarantor

Individual guarantee in cash or other means of payment recognized by the customs authorities as being equivalent to cash deposit, made in Euro or in the currency of the Member State in which the guarantee is registered.

Guarantee waiver where the amount of import or export duty to be secured, does not exceed the statistical value threshold for declarations laid down in accordance with Article 3(4) of regulations (EC) N0 471/2009
Guarantee not required for certain public bodies
For guarantee not required for goods carried by fix transport installations (article 89(8) (b) of the Code)

For individual guarantee in another form which provides equivalent assurance that the amount of import or export duty corresponding to the customs debt and other charges will be paid (Article 92(1)(c) of the Code)
Guarantee not required for goods carried on the Rhine, the Rhine waterways, the Danube or the Danube waterways (Article 89(8)(a) of the Code)
